item.title: Pedestrian crossing permanently activated, 27th September
item.description:
The pedestrian crossing lights for crossing between Cheltenham College and 109 Bath Rd are stuck in a permanently activated state... as though a button to activate the crossing is stuck down. This results in the pedestrian crossing for the entire intersection activating every crossing cycle. This issue began some time between Sat 26th and the morning on Sun 27th. This will likely cause traffic build up as of Monday 28th.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 109-111, Bath Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
